cases.question: How many TV shows have I finished?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fw.content_id) 
FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw
JOIN marts.dim_watchable dc ON dc.content_id = fw.content_id
WHERE fw.content_type = 'tv'
  AND fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'

cases.question: How many books have I read?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM marts.fact_reading_history fw
WHERE fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'

cases.question: How many Hindi movies have I watched?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw
JOIN marts.dim_watchable dc ON dc.content_id = fw.content_id
WHERE dc.original_language = 'hi'
  AND fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'
  AND dc.content_type = 'movie'

cases.question: How many titles are on my watchlist that I haven't started?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(fw.content_id) FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw 
JOIN marts.dim_watchable dc ON dc.content_id = fw.content_id
WHERE fw.consumption_status = 'planned'

cases.question: How many comedies have I watched?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw
JOIN marts.bridge_content_genre bcg ON bcg.content_id = fw.content_id
JOIN marts.dim_genre dg ON dg.genre_id = bcg.genre_id
WHERE fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'
  AND dg.genre_name ILIKE 'comedy'

cases.question: What is my highest rated movie?
cases.detail: got ('Dhurandhar', 'movie', 10), expected one of ['Tumbbad', 'Badla', 'Mumbai Pune Mumbai', 'Dhurandhar', 'Dhurandhar: The Revenge']
cases.sql:
SELECT dc.title, dc.content_type, fw.rating
FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw
JOIN marts.dim_watchable dc ON dc.content_id = fw.content_id
WHERE fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'
  AND fw.content_type = 'movie'
ORDER BY fw.rating DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which genre have I watched the most?
cases.sql:
SELECT dg.genre_name, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw
JOIN marts.bridge_content_genre bcg ON bcg.content_id = fw.content_id
JOIN marts.dim_genre dg ON dg.genre_id = bcg.genre_id
WHERE fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'
GROUP BY dg.genre_name
ORDER BY n DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

cases.question: Which genre do I rate the lowest?
cases.detail: got ('Science Fiction', 6.46, 13), expected one of ['Science Fiction']
cases.sql:
SELECT dg.genre_name, AVG(fw.rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw
JOIN marts.bridge_content_genre bcg ON bcg.content_id = fw.content_id
JOIN marts.dim_genre dg ON dg.genre_id = bcg.genre_id
WHERE fw.content_type IN ('movie', 'tv')
  AND fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'
GROUP BY dg.genre_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY avg_rating ASC

cases.question: Which director's movies do I rate highest?
cases.detail: got ('Aditya Dhar', 9.67), expected one of ['Aditya Dhar']
cases.sql:
SELECT dc.primary_creator, AVG(fw.rating) AS avg_rating
FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw
JOIN marts.dim_watchable dc ON dc.content_id = fw.content_id
WHERE fw.content_type = 'movie'
  AND fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'
GROUP BY dc.primary_creator
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

cases.question: Which author have I read the most books by?
What is the longest book I've read?
Which streaming platform has the most of what I've watched?
cases.sql:
SELECT dp.platform_name, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM marts.bridge_content_platform bcp
JOIN marts.dim_platform dp ON dp.platform_id = bcp.platform_id
LEFT JOIN marts.fact_watch_history fw ON fw.content_id = bcp.content_id
WHERE fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'
GROUP BY dp.platform_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST

cases.question: Have I watched more movies or more TV shows?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw
WHERE fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'
  AND fw.content_type IN ('movie', 'tv')

cases.question: Which titles did I rate 10?
cases.sql:
SELECT dc.title, fw.rating 
FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw 
JOIN marts.dim_watchable dc ON dc.content_id = fw.content_id
WHERE fw.consumption_status = 'consumed' AND fw.rating = 10 
ORDER BY fw.rating DESC NULLS LAST

cases.question: Which TV shows am I currently watching?
cases.sql:
SELECT dc.title, fw.rating
FROM marts.fact_watch_history fw
JOIN marts.dim_watchable dc ON dc.content_id = fw.content_id
WHERE fw.consumption_status = 'in_progress'
  AND fw.content_type = 'tv'

cases.question: Which Marathi titles have I watched?
cases.sql:
SELECT dc.title
FROM marts.dim_watchable dc
JOIN marts.fact_watch_history fw ON fw.content_id = dc.content_id
WHERE dc.original_language = 'mr'
  AND fw.consumption_status = 'consumed'

cases.question: Which books did I rate 5 or lower?
cases.sql:
SELECT db.title, fw.rating
FROM marts.fact_reading_history fw
JOIN marts.dim_book db ON db.content_id = fw.content_id
WHERE fw.rating <= 5

cases.question: English comedies I haven't seen yet
cases.sql:
SELECT dc.title, dc.content_type
FROM marts.dim_watchable dc
JOIN marts.bridge_content_genre bcg ON bcg.content_id = dc.content_id
JOIN marts.dim_genre dg ON dg.genre_id = bcg.genre_id
LEFT JOIN marts.fact_watch_history fw ON fw.content_id = dc.content_id
WHERE dc.original_language = 'en'
  AND dg.genre_name ILIKE 'comedy'
  AND dc.vote_count >= 10
  AND fw.content_id IS NULL
LIMIT 10

cases.question: TV shows on Prime that I haven't watched
cases.sql:
SELECT dc.title, dc.content_type
FROM marts.dim_watchable dc
JOIN marts.bridge_content_platform bcp ON bcp.content_id = dc.content_id
JOIN marts.dim_platform dp ON dp.platform_id = bcp.platform_id
LEFT JOIN marts.fact_watch_history fw ON fw.content_id = dc.content_id
WHERE dp.platform_name ILIKE '%prime%'
  AND fw.content_id IS NULL
AND dc.content_type = 'tv'
